sources.text:
Aulanko Nature Reserve (Finnish: Aulangon luonnonsuojelualue) is a nature reserve in Finland near the municipality of Hämeenlinna. It is a part of Finland's National Urban Park policy introduced in the Land Use and Building Act in 1991.
